text.en:
■ Activates when any ally's HP (including this unit's) drops to {1}% or below while the target has any tickets. Affects the target.
Restores HP equal to {2}% of the skill user's final max HP.
Ticket count ▼ {3}.
■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects all allies.
First Train Discount for {4} sec.
Function: The effect of I'll Help You Board the Train! will not use any tickets.
